Abstract: In this paper, we propose SGFormer++, a novel Semantic Graph Transformer for 3D scene graph generation (SGG), which aims to parse point cloud scenes into semantic structural graphs, where nodes denote detected object instances and edges encode their pairwise relationships, with the core challenge lying in modeling complex global scene structure. While existing graph convolutional network (GCN)-based methods suffer from over-smoothing and limited receptive fields, SGFormer++ leverages Transformer layers as its backbone to enable global message passing. Specifically, we introduce two key components tailored for 3D SGG: (1) a Graph Embedding Layer++ that efficiently integrates edge-aware global context with linear computational complexity, and (2) a Semantic Injection Layer++ that enriches visual features with linguistic priors from large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), boosting semantic representation without introducing extra trainable parameters. To further address the practical challenge of incremental SGG (I-SGG), where new relationship categories arrive sequentially, we equip SGFormer++ with a novel Spatial-guided Feature Adapter, which calibrates predicate features using subject-object spatial geometry to counter scale variation, and a Cascaded Binary Prediction Head that mitigates catastrophic forgetting via task-incremental classifier expansion and logit distillation. Extensive experiments on the 3DSSG benchmark demonstrate that SGFormer++ achieves state-of-the-art performance in both standard and incremental settings: it yields a significant 4.49% absolute improvement in Predicate A@1 under the incremental setting. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/Andy20178/SGFormer.

</details>


### [94] [CausalDrive: Real-time Causal World Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15341)
*Tianyi Yan,Huan Zheng,Dubing Chen,Meizhi Qu,Yingying Shen,Lijun Zhou,Mingfei Tu,Bing Wang,Guang Chen,Hangjun Ye,Haiyang Sun,Cheng-zhong Xu,Jianbing Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CausalDrive 是一种可控、实时的基础世界驾驶渲染器，仅依赖初始前视图、自车轨迹和宏观文本提示，无需未来NPC布局即可预测因果交互，通过Context-Forced DMD架构实现12FPS的交互速度，支持闭环评估、强化学习后训练和人在环仿真等下游应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型在自动驾驶数据扩展中存在两类局限：基于布局条件的方法需要所有背景智能体的"预言"未来轨迹，严格非反应式；纯动作条件预测器缺乏对复杂交互的语义控制，且扩散延迟过高，阻碍了闭环策略学习。CausalDrive旨在解决这些差距。

Method: 提出Context-Forced DMD架构，结合连续流匹配（flow-matching）与自纠正蒸馏目标（self-correcting distillation objective），实现12FPS的交互式生成速度；模型仅以初始前视图、自车轨迹和宏观文本提示为输入，排除未来NPC布局以强制模型内在地预测因果交互，实现文本驱动的驾驶社会学控制。

Result: 实现12FPS的交互式生成速度，在三种下游应用中验证有效性：(1)生成式闭环评估显著减轻碰撞伪影；(2)通过Video2Reward模块进行大规模强化学习后训练；(3)实时人在环仿真。实验表明在CausalDrive反应式场景中训练的策略在真实世界中表现更优。

Conclusion: CausalDrive将被动视频生成器转变为可玩的神经模拟器，通过因果预测和高效架构弥合了现有世界模型在自动驾驶交互仿真中的关键空白，证明了其在闭环策略学习与评估中的有效性。

Abstract: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for scaling autonomous driving (AD) data, yet existing video generative models fall short as interactive simulators. Layout-conditioned renderers rely on "oracle" future trajectories of all background agents, rendering them strictly non-reactive. Conversely, pure action-conditioned predictors lack semantic control over complex interactions and suffer from prohibitive diffusion latencies, hindering closed-loop policy learning. To bridge this gap, we present CausalDrive, a controllable, real-time foundation driving world renderer. CausalDrive operates solely on the initial front-view frame, the ego-vehicle's trajectory, and a macroscopic text prompt. By excluding future NPC layouts, we compel the model to intrinsically predict causal interactions, enabling text-driven control over Driving Sociology, allowing users to dynamically orchestrate diverse counterfactual reactions to identical ego-actions. To overcome the efficiency bottleneck and address the covariate shift in autoregressive generation, we propose a novel Context-Forced DMD architecture. This combines continuous flow-matching with a self-correcting distillation objective, achieving interactive speeds of 12 FPS. This breakthrough transforms the passive video generator into a playable neural simulator. We demonstrate its versatility across three downstream applications: (1) generative closed-loop evaluation with significantly mitigated collision artifacts, (2) large-scale Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training driven by a Video2Reward module, and (3) real-time human-in-the-loop simulation. Extensive experiments validate that policies trained within CausalDrive's reactive scenarios exhibit superior interaction capabilities in the real world.

</details>


### [95] [DYNA-PRUNER: Input-Adaptive Data-Model Co-Pruning for Efficient and Scalable Spatio-Temporal Media Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15346)
*Fuyan Zhang,Yuqi Li,Yingli Tian,Edmond S. L. Ho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Dyna-Pruner框架，通过输入依赖的数据-模型联合剪枝，在时空预测任务中减少高达70%的FLOPs并实现2.5倍加速，同时保持精度损失小于1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时空预测模型计算密集且与输入冗余不匹配（如平静海面、晴朗天空），难以实时部署，需要自动化、资源感知的架构优化方法。

Method: 提出Dyna-Pruner端到端框架，通过共享重要性同步机制生成耦合掩码，同时剪枝冗余区域及其对应的计算单元（如卷积滤波器），实现推理时每样本稀疏子网络。

Result: 在WeatherBench、SEVIR和TaxiBJ数据集上，与CNN、RNN、Transformer骨干网络无缝集成，FLOPs降低70%，在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上实现2.5倍加速，精度损失<1%。

Conclusion: Dyna-Pruner通过数据-模型联合动态剪枝，有效解决了时空预测中计算冗余问题，实现了高效的实时部署。

Abstract: Spatio-temporal prediction supports radar/satellite nowcasting and city-scale traffic monitoring, but modern models are often too expensive for real-time deployment. This stems from a mismatch between dense computation and strong input-dependent redundancy (e.g., calm seas or clear skies). To enable automated, resource-aware architecture optimization in scalable media analysis, we propose Dyna-Pruner, an end-to-end framework for input-dependent co-pruning of data and model structure. A shared-importance synchronization mechanism generates coupled masks that prune redundant regions and their corresponding computational units (e.g., convolutional filters), yielding per-sample sparse sub-networks at inference time. Experiments on WeatherBench, SEVIR, and TaxiBJ show seamless integration with CNN, RNN, and Transformer backbones, reducing FLOPs by up to $70\%$ and achieving a $2.5\times$ speedup on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin with negligible accuracy loss ($<1\%$).

</details>


### [96] [Facial Affect Analysis for Service-Oriented Systems: Advances, Challenges, and Future Visions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15351)
*Spyridon Georgiou,Aggelos Psiris,Thomas Lagkas,Vasileios Argyriou,Panagiotis Sarigiannidis,Iraklis Varlamis,Georgios Th. Papadopoulos*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文回顾了面部情感分析从独立识别任务向面向服务软件生态系统中可复用感知能力演进的进展，强调系统级工程需求（鲁棒性、延迟、公平性、隐私等）比基准性能提升更重要，并提出了将FAA作为可操作服务组件的路线图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推动FAA从独立的识别任务向面向服务软件生态系统中的可复用感知能力转变，解决当前FAA研究在系统工程化部署中的不足，特别是鲁棒性、延迟、公平性、隐私等非功能性需求被忽视的问题。

Method: 通过系统综述回顾静态/动态表情分析、动作单元和微表情建模、CNN/Transformer/图/混合架构等进展，从系统工程视角（服务契约、延迟与可用性包络、生命周期监控、治理感知集成、互操作性）解读这些进展在边缘/云/混合服务管道中的适用性。

Result: 分析表明仅靠基准性能提升不足以满足SoSE就绪度要求；鲁棒性、干预稳定性、公平性、隐私保护及运行时保证同样关键。

Conclusion: 提出将FAA作为具有明确接口、可测量质量属性和负责任生命周期管理的操作化服务组件的路线图。

Abstract: Facial Affect Analysis (FAA) is evolving from a stand-alone recognition task into a reusable perception capability for Service-Oriented Software Ecosystems (SoSE). This paper preserves the FAA methodological core while reframing recent advances through systems-engineering requirements for composable and dependable services. We review representative progress in static and dynamic expression analysis, action-unit and micro-expression modeling, and modern CNN, Transformer, graph, and hybrid architectures, then interpret these advances by their operational fit in edge, cloud, and hybrid service pipelines. The synthesis emphasizes SoSE concerns that determine deployability: service contracts for uncertainty-aware outputs, latency and availability envelopes, lifecycle monitoring and recalibration, governance-aware integration, and interoperability across independently evolving components. Our analysis shows that benchmark gains alone are insufficient for SoSE readiness; robustness under shift, intervention stability, fairness, privacy posture, and runtime guarantees are equally critical. We conclude with a roadmap for treating FAA as an operational service component with explicit interfaces, measurable quality attributes, and accountable lifecycle management.

</details>


### [97] [Sustainable Face Recognition on Low-Power Devices with VQ-VAE Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15355)
*Christos Chronis,Georgios Th. Papadopoulos,Iraklis Varlamis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于VQ-VAE的可持续、边缘可部署的人脸识别框架，通过紧凑的潜在表征和知识蒸馏实现与SOTA相当的精度，同时显著降低内存和计算需求，适用于低功耗边缘设备。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统人脸识别依赖云端计算密集型模型，导致网络流量大、能耗高、碳足迹重，亟需一种可持续的、适合边缘部署的轻量级解决方案。

Method: 利用VQ-VAE生成紧凑且语义丰富的面部图像潜在表征，结合预训练人脸嵌入模型的知识蒸馏框架，在边缘端实现低内存、低计算需求的高精度人脸识别。VQ-VAE压缩仅保留最具信息量的面部特征，减少网络开销。

Result: 在显著降低内存和计算需求的同时，实现了与SOTA人脸嵌入模型可比的精度；重建图像保留了关键身份特征，提升了鲁棒性。

Conclusion: VQ-VAE结合知识蒸馏的框架为人脸识别提供了一种可持续的边缘部署方案，在保持高精度的同时大幅降低资源消耗和碳足迹，适合低功耗边缘设备。

Abstract: Face recognition has become a cornerstone of modern AI applications, yet conventional approaches often rely on computationally intensive models deployed in cloud environments, leading to increased network traffic, high energy consumption, and a heavy carbon footprint. This work introduces a sustainable, edge-deployable face recognition framework based on Vector-Quantized Variational Autoencoders (VQ-VAE), which generates compact and semantically rich latent representations of facial images. By leveraging the compression capacity and reconstruction quality of VQ-VAE embeddings on the edge and combining them with the power of pre-trained face embeddings in a knowledge distillation setup, our system achieves comparable accuracy to state-of-the-art face embedding models while significantly reducing memory and computation requirements on the edge, making it suitable for low-power edge devices. The integration of VQ-VAE compression minimizes network overhead while keeping the matching accuracy high by retaining only the most informative facial features in the latent space. As a result, the reconstructed images preserve the key identity characteristics, improving the robustness and overall performance of the face embeddings.

</details>


### [98] [MNet++: Extended 2D/3D Networks for Anisotropic Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15370)
*Kirsten Odendaal,Rade Bajic*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文完整复现了面向各向异性医学图像分割的混合2D/3D卷积网络MNet，并在nnU-Net框架下验证其性能。实验在PROMISE前列腺MRI和LiTS肝脏CT上进行，复现结果与原文高度一致。进一步提出两种轻量扩展：学习型融合门控机制（Spatial Gating，DSC提升+0.8%，推理开销<3%）和VMamba状态空间模块（降低Dice变异，LiTS肝脏达95.8% Dice）。两种扩展均保持了对各向异性的鲁棒性（delta Dice=1.5%，1-4mm体素间距）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证MNet在各向异性医学图像分割中的可复现性与性能稳健性，并探索通过自适应融合和状态空间建模进一步提升分割可靠性的潜力。

Method: 在nnU-Net框架内完整复现MNet（混合2D/3D卷积网络）；提出两种轻量扩展：（1）学习型Fusion Gating机制实现自适应2D-3D特征融合；（2）VMamba状态空间模块实现高效长程深度建模。

Result: PROMISE上DSC 89.0±0.9%（与原文差距0.8%）；LiTS肝脏/肿瘤DSC 94.3±1.9%/54.6±3.1%。Spatial Gating提升DSC +0.8%且推理开销<3%；VMamba将PROMISE Dice变异降至±0.7%，LiTS肝脏达95.8% Dice。各向异性鲁棒性：delta Dice=1.5%（1-4mm间距）。

Conclusion: MNet具有良好可复现性，自适应融合与状态空间建模能进一步增强各向异性条件下的分割可靠性，但尚需更多测试以得出确定性结论。

Abstract: This work demonstrates a full reproduction and extension of MNet, a hybrid 2D/3D convolutional network designed for anisotropic medical image segmentation. The original architecture was re-implemented within the nnU-Net framework to verify its reported performance and robustness to variable voxel spacing, known as anisotropy. Experiments were conducted on PROMISE prostate MRI and a controlled subset of LiTS liver CT under matched preprocessing and compute constraints. The reproduced MNet achieved a Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) of 89.0 +/- 0.9% on PROMISE, within 0.8% of the published result, and 94.3 +/- 1.9% / 54.6 +/- 3.1% for liver and tumor segmentation on LiTS, respectively. Two lightweight extensions were further introduced: (1) a learned Fusion Gating mechanism enabling adaptive 2D-3D feature blending, and (2) a VMamba state-space module for efficient long-range depth modelling. The Spatial Gating variant improved DSC by +0.8% with less than 3% inference overhead, while VMamba improved performance consistency, reducing PROMISE Dice variation to +/- 0.7% and achieving the strongest LiTS liver performance at 95.8% Dice. Both extensions preserved MNet robustness to anisotropy, with delta Dice = 1.5% across 1-4 mm voxel spacing. Overall, the study confirms MNet reproducibility and demonstrates that adaptive fusion and state-space modelling have the potential to further strengthen segmentation reliability under anisotropic conditions. However, further tests are required to provide definitive conclusions.

</details>


### [99] [Timestep Rescheduling in Diffusion Inversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15389)
*Shangquan Sun,Ting Gong,Zhirui Liu,Jiamin Wu,Runkai Zhao,Mianxin Liu,Wenqi Ren,Xiaochun Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现扩散模型反演中的偏差严重依赖于时间步长大小，呈现抛物线趋势（在极小和极大时间步长处误差更大），据此提出一种结合全局重缩放与局部动态规划的非均匀时间步调度器，可即插即用、无额外参数开销，显著提升图像重建与编辑效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散反演方法（如DDIM）存在固有的累积偏差误差，且现有工作主要关注不动点问题的求解，却忽视了噪声调度器中时间步长选择对反演保真度的影响。

Method: 提出非均匀时间步调度器，包含两个阶段：(1) 全局重缩放，整体调整时间步分布；(2) 基于局部动态规划的重新调度，策略性地分配计算资源，以最小化整体反演误差。

Result: 实验验证该调度器作为即插即用模块，能一致提升现有反演方法的性能，在图像重建和编辑任务上均取得更优结果。

Conclusion: 通过揭示反演误差与时间步长的抛物线关系，提出的非均匀调度器能有效降低反演误差，无需额外参数或计算开销，是一种通用增强方案。

Abstract: Diffusion inversion, which maps images back to the Gaussian latent space of a diffusion model, is a critical task for image reconstruction and editing. While DDIM enables fast deterministic inversion, it inherently introduces deviations that accumulate into noticeable inversion errors. Existing methods often address this by solving a fixed-point problem but largely overlook how the selection of the diffusion timestep in the noise scheduler influences inversion fidelity. In this work, we reveal that the deviation scale in diffusion inversion is strongly dependent on the timestep size, and exhibits a parabolic trend, with larger errors concentrated at both small and large timesteps. Based on this finding, we propose a simple yet effective nonuniform timestep scheduler that integrates a global rescaling with a local dynamic programming based rescheduling, enabling a strategic allocation of computational effort that minimizes the overall inversion error and preserves higher inversion accuracy. Our method serves as an off-the-shelf enhancement for existing inversion techniques and requires no extra parameters or computational overhead. Through extensive experiments, we verify that integrating our scheduler consistently boosts the performance of existing inversion methods, achieving superior results in image reconstruction and editing.

</details>


### [100] [Segmentation-based Detection for Efficient Multi-Task Spacecraft Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15409)
*Sivaperuman Muniyasamy,Surendar Devasundaram*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种紧凑的MobileNetV3编码器+U-Net解码器架构，用于SPARK 2026挑战赛中的航天器分类、检测与部件分割多任务，无需独立检测头，最终以0.9482总分获得第二名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 太空视觉感知面临标注数据稀缺、光照剧烈变化、低信噪比和高对比度等挑战，现有方法难以同时兼顾计算效率与多任务性能，亟需轻量化、高精度的单模型解决方案。

Method: 采用MobileNetV3作为编码器提取特征，结合U-Net风格解码器实现密集预测；检测结果通过预测的部件掩膜求并集解析得到，避免单独的边界框回归头；整个模型以单模型同时完成分类、检测与细粒度部件分割三项任务。

Result: 整体排行榜得分0.9482，其中分类1.0000、检测0.9788、分割0.8917，在SPARK 2026挑战赛中排名第二。

Conclusion: 轻量级编码器-解码器架构能够在实际的星载视觉系统中实现强大的多任务性能，验证了紧凑模型在太空场景下的有效性与实用性。

Abstract: Vision-based perception is fundamental to Space Situational Awareness and autonomous on-orbit operations such as rendezvous, docking, servicing, and navigation. However, progress in this area is limited by the scarcity of annotated space imagery and by challenging visual-domain characteristics including severe illumination changes, low signal-to-noise ratio, and high contrast. We address Stream 1 of the SPARK 2026 Challenge, which requires a single model for spacecraft classification, detection, and fine-grained component segmentation across multiple target types. We propose a compact architecture that integrates a MobileNetV3 encoder with a U-Net-style decoder, combining computational efficiency with accurate dense prediction. Detection is derived analytically from the union of predicted component masks, avoiding a separate bounding-box regression head in the single-spacecraft setting. Our method achieved an overall leaderboard score of 0.9482, with task-specific scores of 1.0000 in classification, 0.9788 in detection, and 0.8917 in segmentation. The proposed approach ranked second overall in the SPARK 2026 Challenge, demonstrating that lightweight encoder-decoder architectures can deliver strong multi-task performance for practical onboard space vision systems.

</details>


### [101] [From Frames to Temporal Graphs: In-Context Egocentric Action Recognition with Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15417)
*Bessie Dominguez-Dager,Francisco Gomez-Donoso,Miguel Cazorla,Marc Pollefeys,Daniel Barath,Zuria Bauer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将第一人称视频中的动作推理问题解耦为视觉感知和符号推理两个阶段：通过多阶段提示管道将视频转换为时序动作图（Temporal Action Graphs），利用大语言模型进行符号推理。实验表明，在EGTEA和Epic-Kitchens-100数据集上，符号化表示能有效支持上下文学习，且当前VLM更适合作为符号推理器而非直接视觉观察者，为免微调的可扩展方案提供了新方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用视觉-语言模型（VLM）在处理第一人称视频中细粒度的手物交互动作推理时，直接基于原始像素的效果不佳，难以捕捉精细的交互过渡。现有端到端方法依赖大量标注数据进行微调，缺乏可扩展性和灵活性。

Method: 提出多阶段提示管道：（1）将视频分割为短时间窗口，生成密集的自然语言叙述作为语义瓶颈；（2）将这些叙述形式化为结构化的、开放词汇的图表示（时序动作图）；（3）基于图的符号表示进行上下文学习（few-shot）或零样本推理，利用VLM作为符号推理器。

Result: 在EGTEA和Epic-Kitchens-100数据集上，few-shot图演示相比零样本帧和图推理均有显著准确率提升；零样本图推理与像素推理竞争力相当。在6个模型家族11个开源VLM（2B-235B参数）上结论一致。

Conclusion: 当前VLM作为符号推理器比直接视觉观察者更有效；将视频投影到语言领域提供了一种可扩展、免微调的替代方案，能更好地利用VLM的潜在推理能力。

Abstract: Action reasoning in egocentric video requires capturing fine-grained transitions of hand-object interactions, a task where general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often struggle when operating directly on raw pixels. We propose to decouple visual perception from symbolic reasoning by converting videos into Temporal Action Graphs. In a multi-stage prompting pipeline, we first generate dense natural language narratives over short temporal windows as a semantic bottleneck, then formalize them into structured, open-vocabulary graph representations. On the EGTEA and Epic-Kitchens-100 datasets, the symbolic representation unlocks efficient in-context learning: few-shot graph demonstrations yield substantial accuracy gains over zero-shot frame and graph-based inference alike. Even in the zero-shot setting, graph-based reasoning remains competitive with pixel-based inference despite potential pretraining contamination favoring the latter. Across 11 open-weight VLMs from 6 model families ranging from 2B to 235B parameters, our findings indicate that current VLMs are more effective as symbolic reasoners than as direct visual observers. By projecting video into the language domain, we provide a scalable, fine-tuning-free alternative to end-to-end approaches that better leverages these models' latent reasoning strengths. The code will be made public.

</details>


### [102] [Lesion-DDPM: Lesion-Enhanced 3D Diffusion for MS MRI Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15457)
*Weidong Zhang,Yongchan Jung,Shafayat Mowla Anik,Furen Xiao,Vasudevan Janarthanan,Enkhzaya Chuluunbaatar,Byeong Kil Lee,Jeeho Ryoo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Lesion-DDPM，一种结合多级解剖掩膜注入和病灶加权重建损失的3D条件扩散框架，用于多发性硬化症中病灶感知的FLAIR图像合成。该方法在病灶区域重建误差最低，且下游分割任务中仅用合成数据训练达到0.616 Dice，加入真实数据后提升至0.685。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开MS数据集规模小、跨扫描仪和协议差异大，限制了鲁棒性机器学习模型开发，尤其对需要保留小稀疏病灶的生成模型构成挑战。

Method: 提出Lesion-DDPM，一个3D条件扩散模型，通过多级解剖掩膜注入实现条件控制，并设计病灶加权重建损失以强调病灶体素同时保持全局大脑结构。

Result: Lesion-DDPM在所有方法中取得最低病灶区域重建误差；仅用其合成数据训练的3D U-Net在下游分割任务中Dice达0.616（最佳对比方法为0.569）；加入真实训练集后Dice提升至0.685。

Conclusion: Lesion-DDPM能够有效合成病灶感知的3D FLAIR图像，在图像质量和下游分割任务中均优于现有GAN和扩散模型，有助于缓解MS数据稀缺和异质性问题。

Abstract: 3D FLAIR MRI is widely recommended as one of the standard MRI sequences for brain imaging in multiple sclerosis (MS), but publicly available MS datasets remain relatively small and vary across scanners, acquisition protocols, and lesion patterns. This scarcity and variability hinder the development of robust neuroimaging machine learning models and are particularly challenging for generative models that aim to synthesize images while preserving small, sparse lesions. We propose Lesion-DDPM, a 3D conditional diffusion framework for lesion-aware FLAIR synthesis that incorporates multi-level anatomical mask injection together with a lesion-weighted reconstruction loss to emphasize lesion voxels while maintaining global brain structure. Using a curated subset of the MSLesSeg dataset, we compare Lesion-DDPM with representative state-of-the-art GAN- and diffusion-based models, assessing both image-generation metrics and downstream 3D U-Net segmentation. In our experiments, Lesion-DDPM achieved the lowest lesion-region reconstruction error among all methods. In a downstream 3D U-Net lesion segmentation task, a model trained only on Lesion-DDPM-generated scans and evaluated on real MRIs reached a Dice score of 0.616 compared with 0.569 for the best competing synthetic dataset. When Lesion-DDPM images were added to the real training set, the Dice score further increased to 0.685.

</details>


### [103] [Analyzing Visual Aircraft Representations with Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15468)
*Deepshik Sharma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文使用稀疏自编码器分解ConvNeXt视觉模型在FGVC-Aircraft数据集上的中间表征，发现学习到的稀疏特征部分可解释，对应飞机结构，但也存在多义性和空间定位粗糙等局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉模型在分类任务上表现优异，但其内部表征难以解释，本文旨在探究稀疏自编码器是否能将视觉模型的中间表征分解为可解释的特征。

Method: 在FGVC-Aircraft数据集上训练ConvNeXt分类器，提取最终特征层的空间激活，训练稀疏自编码器；通过最高激活图像块、激活强度和类别选择性分析稀疏特征，并使用输入空间和特征空间消融实验评估特征影响。

Result: 部分稀疏特征对应可识别的飞机结构和视觉模式；消融实验表明这些特征与类别相关，影响logits、分类边际和预测置信度；同时发现多义性和空间定位粗糙等局限性。

Conclusion: 稀疏自编码器能够揭示视觉模型中部分可解释、与类别相关的特征，但存在多义性和空间定位不佳等问题，仍需进一步改进。

Abstract: Vision models can achieve strong performance on classification tasks, but the internal representations supporting their predictions are often difficult to interpret. This work investigates whether sparse autoencoders can decompose intermediate representations of a vision model into interpretable features. We train a ConvNeXt classifier on the FGVC-Aircraft dataset, extract spatial activations from its final feature stage, and train a sparse autoencoder on these activations. The learned sparse features are analyzed using top-activating image patches, activation strength, and class selectivity. Qualitative visual inspection reveals that several features correspond to recognizable aircraft structures and visual patterns. We evaluate a subset of selected features using input-space and feature-space ablations, measuring how blurring image patches and suppressing sparse features affect class logits, classification margins, and prediction confidence. The results suggest that sparse autoencoders can reveal partially interpretable, class-relevant visual features associated with aircraft recognition, while also exposing limitations such as polysemanticity and coarse spatial localization.

</details>


### [104] [ST-DiffEye: Diffusion-based Continuous Gaze Generation via Joint Scanpath-Trajectory Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15486)
*Brian Nlong Zhao,Ozgur Kara,Junho Kim,James M. Rehg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ST-DiffEye，一种联合眼动轨迹与扫描路径的扩散框架，通过将两种模态拼接为额外输入通道进行协同训练，并引入基于CRPS的评估体系，在视觉搜索和自由观看任务上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式注视模型仅对眼动轨迹或扫描路径中的单一表征进行监督训练，忽略了二者在不同尺度上互补描述注视行为的特性。本文将注视变异性视为固有属性而非噪声，旨在通过联合建模捕捉注视的随机生成过程。

Method: 提出ST-DiffEye扩散框架，将连续眼动轨迹与离散扫描路径拼接为额外输入通道，无需额外架构开销；同时提出基于连续排序概率评分（CRPS）的评估框架，将任意序列相似性度量推广为同时评估准确性与多样性的恰当评分规则。

Result: 在任务驱动视觉搜索（含目标存在与目标缺失场景）及自由观看基准上均取得SOTA性能，消融实验验证了联合建模与分布感知评估的有效性。

Conclusion: 联合建模轨迹与扫描路径能互补地捕获注视的多尺度特征，CRPS评估框架能更好地反映人类注视的内在变异性，为注视生成模型提供了更可靠的评估范式。

Abstract: We study the problem of human gaze modeling, which aims to generate the gaze patterns a viewer produces while observing a visual stimulus. Gaze is primarily captured through two modalities: continuous eye-tracking trajectories, which describe fine-grained motion dynamics, and discrete scanpaths, which describe high-level fixation structure. Because gaze varies substantially across viewers and trials, we treat this variability as a defining property rather than noise and model gaze as a stochastic generative process. Existing generative gaze models supervise on only one of these two representations in isolation. We hypothesize that trajectories and scanpaths describe gaze at complementary scales and are jointly informative during training, and test this hypothesis through ST-DiffEye, a joint trajectory-scanpath diffusion framework that couples both modalities by concatenating them as an additional raw input channel, requiring no architectural overhead beyond an input and output channel expansion. We further introduce a principled evaluation framework based on the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS), which generalizes any existing sequence similarity metric into a proper scoring rule that jointly assesses the accuracy and diversity of generated gaze. Experiments on task-driven visual search, covering both target-present and target-absent scenarios, and on free-viewing benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. These results, along with detailed ablations, confirm the benefit of joint modeling and the value of distribution-aware evaluation in capturing the intrinsic variability of human gaze. Project webpage: https://st-diffeye.github.io/

</details>


### [105] [Selective Synergistic Learning for Video Object-Centric Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15527)
*WonJun Moon,Jae-Pil Heo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对视频目标中心学习中编码器与解码器特征图不一致导致的信息传播问题，提出SSync方法，通过选择性蒸馏可靠线索（编码器用于边界细化、解码器用于内部去噪）及传递式伪标签合并机制，以线性复杂度实现高效对齐，显著提升分解质量且鲁棒性强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有密集对齐策略强制所有时空块一致，导致编码器的噪声预测和解码器的模糊边界等固有缺陷被传播，且二次计算复杂度限制了可扩展性。

Method: 提出Selective Synergistic Learning (SSync)：1）选择性蒸馏——编码器仅用于边界细化，解码器仅用于内部去噪，避免错误传播；2）伪标签方法实现线性复杂度对齐；3）传递式伪标签合并，基于时空激活一致性合并重叠槽，缓解槽冗余。

Result: SSync显著提升分解质量，作为即插即用模块具有优越鲁棒性，对各种槽配置表现稳定。

Conclusion: SSync通过选择性协同学习有效克服了传统对齐策略的缺陷，在提升性能的同时降低了计算复杂度，为视频目标中心学习提供了高效且鲁棒的解决方案。

Abstract: Typical video object-centric learning (VOCL) approaches employ slot-based frameworks that rely on reconstruction-driven encoder-decoder architectures, where learning is mediated by two spatial maps: attention maps from the encoder and object maps from the decoder. As these two distinct maps exhibit different properties, a recent dense alignment strategy attempted to reconcile this discrepancy by enforcing agreement across all spatio-temporal patches via contrastive learning. However, this indiscriminate alignment inadvertently propagates the inherent weaknesses of each module, such as noisy encoder predictions and blurred decoder boundaries. Moreover, computing dense similarities across all pairs incurs a computational cost quadratic in the total number of spatio-temporal patches, severely limiting scalability. Motivated by this, we propose Selective Synergistic Learning (SSync). Instead of exhaustive patch-to-patch alignment, SSync prevents error propagation by selectively distilling only the most reliable cues: leveraging the encoder strictly for boundary refinement and the decoder for interior denoising. This is realized via a pseudo-labeling with linear complexity, eliminating the need for quadratic spatial comparisons. Also, to prevent the reinforcement of architectural biases like slot redundancy, we introduce a transitive pseudo-label merging that consolidates overlapping slots based on spatio-temporal activation consistency. Extensive studies demonstrate that SSync improves decomposition quality and serves as a versatile, plug-and-play module while also exhibiting exceptional robustness to slot configurations. Code is available at github.com/wjun0830/SSync.

</details>


### [106] [Track2View: 4D-Consistent Camera-Controlled Video Generation via Paired 3D Point Tracks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15534)
*Feng Qiao,Zhaochong An,Zhexiao Xiong,Serge Belongie,Nathan Jacobs*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Track2View 提出利用显式3D点轨迹（稀疏、时间连续的空间点对应）作为条件，引导视频扩散变压器从源视角重新渲染目标视角视频，在400段视频基准上显著优于现有方法，旋转和翻译误差分别降低30-65%和61-72%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频视角重渲染方法依赖逐帧位姿嵌入、噪声点云渲染或隐式学习对应，缺乏显式的、时间连续的源-目标像素连接，导致时序一致性和视角准确性不足。

Method: 1) 将显式3D点轨迹（稀疏场景点投影到源和目标相机视图）作为条件输入视频扩散变压器；2) 设计双视图轨迹调节器，通过无参数几何操作和学习的时序聚合，将源视图视觉上下文传递到目标视图；3) 构建数据管线，利用3D点追踪器从多相机视图对中提取一一对应的轨迹。

Result: 在包含静态和动态场景的400段视频基准上，Track2View 在视觉质量、视图同步和相机精度方面达到SOTA，旋转误差降低30-65%，翻译误差降低61-72%。

Conclusion: 显式3D点轨迹作为条件信号能有效建立源-目标视角间的时空对应，提升视频新视角合成的质量和一致性，且具有良好的泛化能力。

Abstract: Re-rendering an existing video from a novel camera viewpoint requires the output to follow the prescribed camera trajectory while preserving the appearance and dynamics of the original scene across every frame. Existing methods rely on per-frame pose embeddings, noisy point-cloud renderings, or implicit learned correspondences, none of which provides an explicit, temporally continuous link between source and target pixels. We propose Track2View, which conditions a video diffusion transformer on paired 3D point tracks: sparse trajectories of scene points projected into both the source and target camera views. These tracks provide explicit spatiotemporal correspondences that are temporally continuous by construction, encoding what content should appear where and when. At the core of Track2View is a dual-view track conditioner that transfers visual context from source to target view through parameter-free geometric operations and learned temporal aggregation, ensuring generalization to arbitrary camera trajectories without memorizing specific motions. We further introduce a data curation pipeline that extracts one-to-one track correspondences by running a 3D point tracker on temporally concatenated multi-camera view pairs. On a 400-video benchmark spanning static and dynamic scenes, Track2View achieves state-of-the-art results across visual quality, view synchronization, and camera accuracy, reducing rotation error by 30-65% and translation error by 61-72% relative to leading baselines. Project page is available at this https URL: https://qjizhi.github.io/track2view

</details>


### [107] [EcoBin: A Two-Stage Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Contamination-Aware Waste Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15547)
*Raghav Senthil Kumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EcoBin双阶段卷积神经网络，在垃圾分类中显式处理污染问题。第一阶段用EfficientNetV2-S对30类垃圾进行四类处置路径分类，第二阶段用U2-Net合成污染数据训练污染检测器，对判定为可回收的进行污染检测并可能改判为垃圾。包含污染检测后，管道正确率从1/25提升至24/25，p<0.001显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有垃圾分类模型虽在基准数据集上准确率超过95%，但未能处理可回收物中的污染问题（如带食物残渣的容器），导致实际回收效率降低。

Method: 两阶段深度卷积神经网络EcoBin：第一阶段基于EfficientNetV2-S的30类基础分类器，将废物归入四种处置路径；第二阶段污染分类器，使用U2-Net分割干净物品与合成污染纹理生成训练数据，检测可回收物中的污染并决定是否改判为垃圾。

Result: 第一阶段测试准确率87.42%，路径调整准确率96.13%。污染检测器ROC-AUC为0.99。完整管道在受污染可回收物测试集上正确路由24/25，基础分类器仅1/25。McNemar检验p<0.001，差异显著。

Conclusion: 双阶段架构显式建模污染能大幅提升实际场景下的垃圾分类效果，污染检测阶段带来的改进在统计上显著。

Abstract: Waste classification models have become highly accurate at sorting waste, often exceeding 95% on benchmark datasets. However, these models fail to account for contamination in recyclable waste. We present EcoBin, a two-stage deep convolutional neural network that classifies household waste by its disposal pathway and that explicitly accounts for contamination. The first stage is a base waste classifier built on an EfficientNetV2-S backbone that assigns each of the thirty waste categories in our dataset to one of four disposal pathways. The second stage is a contamination classifier that inspects any item routed toward recycling and overrides the decision to garbage when contamination is detected. Because no public dataset of contaminated recyclables exists, we synthesize one by segmenting images of clean recyclable objects with a U2-Net model and compositing realistic contamination textures onto their surfaces. The first stage achieves 87.42% test accuracy and a 96.13% pathway-adjusted accuracy. Meanwhile, the contamination stage distinguishes clean from contaminated items with a 0.99 ROC-AUC. On a test set of contaminated recyclables, the complete pipeline routes 24 of 25 items correctly, compared with only 1 of 25 for the base classifier alone. A McNemar's test confirms that the improvement contributed by the contamination stage is statistically significant (p < 0.001).

</details>


### [108] [RaLMPH: Reliability-aware Learning for Multi-Pathologist Harmonization in Whole-Slide Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15554)
*Sungrae Hong,Jiwon Jeong,Soeun Cheon,Donghee Han,Sol Lee,Jisu Shin,Kyungeun Kim,Mun Yong Yi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RaLMPH框架，通过可靠性场联合建模局部邻域结构和专家不确定性，实现多病理学家标注的WSI标签协调，在临床和模拟数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MIL方法假设每张WSI只有一个黄金标签，忽略了病理学家间存在显著标注差异的临床现实；已有的多标注器学习和标签精炼方法要么估计全局标注者可靠性，要么依赖单实例假设，不适用于MIL和局部诊断场景。

Method: 提出RaLMPH框架，包含：(i) 可靠性场，联合建模WSI特征空间中的局部邻域结构和专家不确定性(熵)；(ii) 基于该场的逐样本局部标注者排序，选择每个切片的可靠意见；(iii) 自适应门控机制，根据局部可靠性融合标签。

Result: 在六位病理学家标注的临床WSI数据集和受控模拟基准上，RaLMPH一致优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 可靠性感知机制有效改进了标签协调和下游MIL性能，适用于多病理学家标注的WSI分析场景。

Abstract: Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) is a standard paradigm for Whole-Slide Image (WSI) analysis and has achieved strong results in computational pathology. However, most MIL pipelines assume a single "gold" label per slide, which conflicts with clinical practice where substantial inter-pathologist variability is common. Existing multi-annotator learning and label-refinement methods typically estimate global annotator reliability or rely on single-instance assumptions, making them poorly suited to MIL and to localized diagnostic contexts where experts disagree. We propose RaLMPH (Reliability-aware Learning for Multi-Pathologist Harmonization), a MIL-based label reconciliation framework for WSIs annotated by multiple pathologists. RaLMPH introduces a reliability field that jointly models (i) local neighborhood structure in WSI feature space and (ii) expert uncertainty (entropy), enabling per-sample identification of trustworthy reference neighborhoods. Leveraging this field, RaLMPH performs sample-wise local annotator ranking to select reliable opinions per slide and applies an adaptive gating mechanism to fuse labels conditioned on local reliability. Experiments on a clinical WSI dataset with labels from six pathologists, as well as controlled simulated benchmarks, show that RaLMPH consistently outperforms existing approaches. Further analyses clarify how our reliability-aware mechanism improves label reconciliation and downstream MIL performance.

</details>


### [109] [An Extensive Benchmark for Single-round and Multi-round Instruction-based Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15570)
*Yiwei Ma,Ke Ye,Weihuang Lin,Jiayi Ji,Xiaoshuai Sun,Tat-Seng Chua,Rongrong Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了I2EBench2.0，一个面向单轮和多轮指令式图像编辑的综合评估基准，涵盖16个单轮和7个多轮评价维度，并通过人工对齐实验确保评估可靠性，为未来IIE模型改进提供研究洞见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有指令式图像编辑（IIE）模型缺乏统一、全面的评估框架，由于指令的复杂性和编辑结果的多样性，难以准确衡量模型质量，亟需一个鲁棒的评估基准来指导模型改进。

Method: 构建I2EBench2.0评估基准，支持单轮与多轮编辑评估，设计16个单轮维度和7个多轮维度的评价标准，涵盖高层语义与低层像素质量；通过大规模用户研究确保评价标准与人类判断一致；在8个最新IIE模型上进行实验验证。

Result: 在8个主流IIE模型上完成系统性评估，生成了全面的性能对比结果，分析了各模型在多个维度上的优劣势，代码、数据集和生成图像均已开源。

Conclusion: I2EBench2.0填补了IIE领域缺乏统一评估基准的空白，通过多维度、多轮次评估框架和人工对齐机制，为IIE模型提供了可靠的性能度量标准，所得研究洞见可为未来模型发展方向提供指导。

Abstract: In recent years, there have been notable advancements in the area of instruction-based image editing (IIE), which focuses on the automatic alteration of input images using a model. Nevertheless, assessing the effectiveness of these editing models poses a considerable challenge due to the intricate nature of instructions and the wide variety of edits. To tackle this problem, one urgent task in this domain is the development of a robust evaluation framework that can precisely gauge the quality of editing outcomes and offer valuable benchmarks to guide future improvements. To address this challenge, we present a comprehensive evaluation benchmark named I2EBench2.0, designed for single-round and multi-round assessment of IIE models. I2EBench2.0 has four key features: 1) Evaluation Across Single and Multi-rounds: I2EBench2.0 simultaneously evaluates both single-round and multi-round instruction-based edits, assessing the precision and consistency of the edits. 2) Extensive Evaluation Criteria: I2EBench2.0 encompasses a broad range of criteria, evaluating both high-level and low-level aspects of each IIE model. Specifically, it incorporates 16 dimensions for single-round evaluations and 7 for multi-round evaluations. 3) Alignment with Human Judgment: To ensure our benchmark aligns with human evaluation, we conducted a comprehensive user study for each criterion. 4) Research-driven Insights: By analyzing the strengths and weaknesses of current IIE models across all 16 single-round and 7 multi-round dimensions, we provide critical insights aimed at directing future research in this area. We tested eight recently developed IIE models using I2EBench2.0 and derived academic insights through meticulous comparison and analysis. The related code, dataset, and images generated by all IIE models are available on GitHub: https://github.com/cocoshe/I2EBench.

</details>


### [110] [Toward the Whole Picture: Accumulative Fingerprint Mapping and Reconstruction for Small-Area Mobile Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15574)
*Xiongjun Guan,Jianjiang Feng,Jie Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对移动设备小面积指纹传感中采集与识别的不匹配问题，提出了一种累积式指纹映射与重建的新范式：将多次局部触摸序列转换为统一的指纹图，并在融合后仅进行一次匹配，替代传统的多次局部匹配流程。作者给出了一个经典基线管道（含结构特征提取、配准融合、图谱构建、相位脊重建），并将其置于更广泛的移动指纹框架中（结合结构化令牌学习、两阶段姿态推理、扩散生成重建），实现了从多次捕获多次匹配到累积建图、状态精化、一次匹配的转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动设备的小面积指纹传感存在根本性不匹配：每次触摸仅捕获微小且姿态变化的局部区域，而可靠生物识别需要稳定且完整的指纹表示。现有方法将多次触摸视为独立的局部模板，导致重复注册、重复匹配，且无法保证全局覆盖。

Method: 提出累积式指纹映射与重建范式，具体基线管道包括：局部结构特征提取（如细节点）、特征级配准与融合、指纹图构建、相位基脊线重建。更广泛的框架整合了结构化令牌学习、两阶段姿态推理和扩散生成重建。

Result: 将移动指纹识别从多捕获多匹配处理转变为累积式建图、状态精化与一次匹配，提供了高效、姿态鲁棒且易于部署的生物识别方案。

Conclusion: 累积式指纹映射与重建为小面积移动指纹传感提供了一种原理性路径，通过将局部观察序列转化为统一指纹状态并一次匹配，有效解决了传统方法重复注册与匹配、全局覆盖不足的问题。

Abstract: Small-area fingerprint sensing on mobile devices creates a fundamental mismatch between acquisition and recognition: each touch captures only a tiny, pose-varying local patch, while reliable biometric matching ultimately requires a stable and sufficiently complete fingerprint representation. Existing pipelines largely cope with this mismatch by treating repeated touches as independent partial templates, which leads to repeated registration, repeated matching, and no guarantee of adequate global coverage. In this paper, we advocate a different formulation, namely \emph{accumulative fingerprint mapping and reconstruction} for small-area mobile sensing. Rather than matching every partial patch separately, the proposed perspective converts a sequence of local observations into a unified fingerprint state that is progressively refined as new touches arrive and can be matched only once after consolidation. As a concrete baseline, we present a classical pipeline that performs patch-wise structural feature extraction, feature-level registration and fusion, fingerprint map construction, and phase-based ridge reconstruction. More importantly, we position this baseline within a broader mobile fingerprint framework that integrates structured token learning, two-stage pose reasoning, and diffusion-based generative reconstruction. This viewpoint reframes mobile fingerprint recognition from multi-capture multi-match processing to accumulative map building, state refinement, and one-shot matching, offering a principled route toward efficient, pose-robust, and deployment-friendly biometrics for small-area mobile platforms. The baseline implementation has been publicly released at https://github.com/XiongjunGuan/FpReconstruction.

</details>


### [111] [Unlocking Diffusion Hierarchies: Adaptive Timestep Selection for Zero-Shot Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15590)
*Ramin Nakhli,Mahesh Ramachandran,Luca Ballan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出两种改进以提升基于扩散模型的零样本分割性能：1) 上下文相似度图融合高分辨率注意力图和U-Net编码器特征，提供精细且鲁棒的逐像素表示；2) 发现扩散模型去噪过程中的层次化语义递进特性（从部件级到物体级抽象），并据此设计自适应逐像素最优时间步选择机制。实验表明该方法持续优于现有零样本分割基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的零样本分割方法受限于空间分辨率与上下文信息之间的权衡，以及依赖单一静态时间步进行特征提取的缺陷。

Method: 1) 上下文相似度图：融合高分辨率注意力图与丰富的U-Net编码器特征，得到兼具细粒度和鲁棒性的逐像素表示；2) 层次化时间步选择：发现扩散模型去噪过程中从部件级到物体级的语义递进规律，据此为每个像素自适应选择最优时间步。

Result: 在零样本分割任务上持续超越现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 结合上下文特征与动态层次化时间步选择能有效提升零样本分割性能。

Abstract: Zero-shot segmentation has recently shown notable improvement by leveraging the rich visual priors in large-scale text-to-image diffusion models, such as Stable Diffusion. However, current diffusion-based methods often face limitations due to the trade-off between spatial resolution and contextual information, as well as their reliance on a single static timestep for feature extraction. To overcome these challenges, our work introduces two key advancements. First, our Contextual Similarity Maps fuse high-resolution attention maps with rich U-Net encoder features, providing both fine-grained and robust per-pixel representations. Second, we identify an emergent hierarchical semantic progression within the denoising process of various diffusion models: representations transition from part-level abstractions at earlier timesteps to object-level abstractions at later stages. Leveraging this insight, we introduce a mechanism to adaptively select the optimal timestep for each pixel. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing zero-shot segmentation baselines, validating the efficacy of combining contextual features with dynamic, hierarchical timestep selection.

</details>


### [112] [DenseControl: Instance-Level Controllable Synthesis of Dense Crowd Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15592)
*Juncheng Wang,Lei Shang,Wang Lu,Baigui Sun,Shujun Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DenseControl是一种用于生成密集人群图像的管道，通过IOE图控制位置、ISE策略控制尺度、Position Shortcut机制增强注意力，在密集人群合成上达到SOTA，并展示了数据增强、迁移学习和天气泛化等应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成密集人群图像面临两大挑战：控制信号嵌入困难，以及在传递实例尺度引导时保持拓扑完整性。

Method: 1) 提出孤立对象嵌入(IOE)图实现空间位置控制；2) 提出隐式尺度嵌入(ISE)策略编码精确尺度信息；3) 引入Position Shortcut机制增强交叉注意力，缓解投影挑战。

Result: 在不同控制条件下，DenseControl在密集人群图像合成中达到SOTA结果。在数据稀缺下的人群分析增强、迁移学习和天气泛化场景中展示了实用价值。

Conclusion: DenseControl通过IOE、ISE和Position Shortcut三个创新模块有效解决了密集人群合成中的位置和尺度控制问题，并在多个实际应用场景中证明了其实用性。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce DenseControl, a novel pipeline for generating dense crowd images. Specifically, DenseControl meticulously positions and sizes each generated instance to align precisely with the predefined coordinates and scales. Based on this, we further allow for control over the background, style, and attributes of instances. The motivation behind DenseControl stems from the observation of two main challenges in synthesizing crowd images: controlling signal embedding and maintaining topological integrity when imparting instance scale guidance. To address these, we first introduce the Isolated Object Embedding (IOE) map, a novel representation that facilitates spatial location control while mitigating the difficulties associated with learning projections for model. Secondly, we propose an Implicit Scale Embedding (ISE) strategy that seamlessly integrates with the IOE map to encode precise scale information. To further enhance the efficacy of combining ISE with the IOE map, we incorporate a Position Shortcut mechanism that enhances cross-attention to alleviate projection challenges. We evaluate DenseControl through two lenses: synthesis quality and applicability in latent applications. Experiments across different control conditions demonstrate DenseControl achieves state-of-the-art results in dense crowd image synthesis. Furthermore, we showcase applications in augmenting crowd analysis under data scarcity, transfer learning, and weather generalization scenes, to highlight the practical utility of DenseControl. The codebase will be released.

</details>


### [113] [Fusion-E2Pulse: A Multimodal Event-RGB Fusion Network for Non-contact Pulse Wave Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15597)
*Qian Feng,Hao Guo,Yan Niu,Zhenhuan Xu,Yidi Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为Fusion-E2Pulse的多模态网络，融合RGB帧信号的结构先验和事件流的高灵敏度，实现非接触式脉搏波重建，在心率估计（MAE=0.78 bpm）、波形相关性（0.89）和收缩期相位误差（16.74 ms）上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RGB方法受积分成像机制影响，曝光过程会平滑掉微弱的血管搏动细节；而神经形态事件相机对强度波动敏感但易受微小运动噪声干扰。为利用帧基积分与事件基差分感知的互补优势，提出融合方案。

Method: 提出Fusion-E2Pulse多模态网络，使用滤波后的RGB信号作为结构先验抑制运动伪影，同时利用事件流的高灵敏度恢复精细的形态学细节。

Result: 心率估计MAE为0.78 bpm，波形相关性0.89，收缩期相位持续时间误差16.74 ms，在噪声抑制和形态保真度之间取得平衡，达到SOTA。

Conclusion: Fusion-E2Pulse有效重建了包含重搏切迹等细粒度病理特征的脉搏波，验证了RGB-事件多模态融合在非接触式脉搏波重建中的有效性。

Abstract: Non-contact pulse wave reconstruction hinges on the precise recovery of waveform morphology, including the dicrotic notch. Conventional Red-Green-Blue (RGB)-based methods, which extract physiological signals from recorded facial videos, are constrained by the integral imaging mechanism of standard cameras, where the exposure process induces a smoothing effect that attenuates subtle vascular pulsation details. Conversely, neuromorphic event cameras, while offering exceptional sensitivity to intensity fluctuations, are inherently susceptible to noise and artifacts induced by minor motion. To exploit the synergy between frame-based integration and event-based differential sensing, we propose a novel multimodal network named Fusion-E2Pulse. This framework utilizes filtered RGB signals as structural priors to suppress motion artifacts, while leveraging the high-sensitivity of event streams to recover fine-grained morphological details. Experimental results demonstrate that Fusion-E2Pulse achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively balancing noise suppression and morphological fidelity, achieving a mean absolute error of 0.78 bpm for heart rate estimation, a waveform correlation of 0.89, and a systolic phase duration error of 16.74 ms, validating its efficacy in reconstructing fine-grained pathological features.

</details>


### [114] [Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of SAM 3 for Automated ITV Generation from 4DCT Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15604)
*Changwoo Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个轻量级框架，通过LoRA微调SAM 3模型，仅用7个标注的3D CT体积即可实现4DCT中肺部和心脏结构的精准分割，利用相位相干性过滤伪影，在单张消费级GPU上训练，达到95%以上的全数据准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有4DCT内靶区勾画工作流逐相位独立处理，丢弃了时间相干性，轮廓易受相位特异性伪影影响，亟需一种数据高效且能利用时序信息的解决方案。

Method: 采用LoRA对SAM 3进行参数高效微调，仅用7个标注3D CT体积实现医学领域适配；引入难负样本挖掘策略提升低对比度区域边界判别能力；推断时通过相位相干时序滤波和空间连通性分析，利用呼吸运动的连续周期性抑制瞬态伪影。

Result: 肺部和心脏结构的中位Dice分数分别为0.968和0.910，95百分位Hausdorff距离分别为0.998 mm和2.931 mm，有效消除了未适配SAM 3零样本推断中的严重假阳性，仅用7个标注体积保留超95%全数据准确率。

Conclusion: 该框架展示了可扩展、数据高效的适应性放疗解决方案，可在单张消费级GPU上训练，为临床4DCT分割提供了一种实用的低成本途径。

Abstract: Four-dimensional computed tomography (4DCT) captures the full respiratory cycle of thoracic anatomy, yet current Internal Target Volume contouring workflows process each phase in isolation, discarding temporal coherence and leaving contours vulnerable to phase-specific artifacts. We present a lightweight framework that applies parameter-efficient fine-tuning to the Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) via low-rank adaptation (LoRA) to align its text-prompted segmentation with the medical domain using only seven annotated 3D CT volumes. Furthermore, the framework incorporates a hard negative mining strategy to improve boundary discrimination in low-contrast thoracic regions. At inference, phase-wise predictions are refined through phase-coherent temporal filtering and spatial connectivity analysis. Since respiratory motion is continuous and periodic, genuine anatomy appears in contiguous blocks of phases, whereas transient artifacts appear sporadically and are thus effectively suppressed. Experiments on pulmonary and cardiac structures yield median Dice scores of 0.968 and 0.910 with 95th-percentile Hausdorff distances of 0.998 mm and 2.931 mm, respectively. The proposed framework effectively eliminates the severe false-positive predictions inherent in the zero-shot inference of the unadapted SAM 3. With only seven annotated volumes, the framework retains over 95% of full-data accuracy, and the entire pipeline is trainable on a single consumer-grade GPU, demonstrating a scalable, data-efficient solution for adaptive radiotherapy.

</details>


### [115] [On the Adversarial Robustness of Multimodal LLM Judges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15608)
*Zihan Wang,Guansong Pang,Zelin Liu,Wenjun Miao,Jin Zheng,Xiao Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RobustMLLMJudge框架，系统评估多模态大语言模型作为评判者时的对抗鲁棒性，并进一步提出MGSIA（流形引导语义诱导攻击）方法，通过结合肯定语义诱导与高分流形对齐，实现对MLLM评判者的高效、可迁移分数膨胀攻击，实验表明现有MLLM评判者在此类攻击下高度脆弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）越来越多地被用作自动评判者（如图像质量、安全评估），但其对抗鲁棒性尚未被充分探索，威胁到自动评判的公平性和可靠性。现有研究缺乏针对MLLM作为评判者场景的通用鲁棒性评估框架。

Method: 首先构建RobustMLLMJudge通用框架，涵盖多种攻击方法和评估场景。然后提出MGSIA方法，其核心在于：1）肯定语义诱导——最大化模型对二元语义查询（如"是"）的输出概率；2）高分流形对齐——通过代理协议估计高评分中心，将对抗表示正则化向该中心对齐。二者结合生成可迁移的分数膨胀扰动。

Result: 实验表明：1）不同MLLM评判者对分数膨胀对抗攻击高度脆弱；2）MGSIA相比现有方法具有更优的攻击效果和泛化能力，能在不同评估场景下有效欺骗先进的MLLM评判者。

Conclusion: MLLM作为自动评判者存在严重的对抗鲁棒性缺陷，MGSIA揭示了其易被攻破的风险，强调了构建鲁棒MLLM评判者的必要性。代码和数据集将开源。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges, e.g., for image quality and safety assessment. However, their adversarial robustness remains largely unexplored, threatening the fairness and reliability of automated judging. To bridge this gap, we introduce RobustMLLMJudge, the first general framework for evaluating the adversarial robustness of general-purpose MLLMs when functioning as judges. It covers diverse attacks against popular judge approaches across quality and safety evaluation scenarios. Using RobustMLLMJudge, we reveal that i) different MLLM judges are highly vulnerable to score-inflating adversarial attacks; and ii) although effective, these attack methods face a critical challenge due to unique constraints in the evaluation protocols of MLLM judges. We further propose MGSIA, namely Manifold-Guided Semantic Induction Attack, a novel method that bypasses these constraints to enable more effective and transferable attacks on MLLM judges. The core idea of MGSIA is to combine affirmative semantic induction with high-score manifold alignment: it maximizes the probability that judges yield affirmative responses (e.g., "Yes") to binary semantic queries, while regularizing adversarial representations toward high-score centers estimated from proxy protocols. Together, these objectives yield transferable score-inflating perturbations. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority and generalizability of MGSIA in deceiving advanced MLLM judges under different evaluation scenarios, highlighting the need for robust MLLM judges. Code and data will be made available at https://github.com/mala-lab/RobustMLLMJudge.

</details>


### [116] [Mutual Distillation of Dual-Foundation Models for Semi-Supervised PET/CT Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15611)
*Fuyou Mao,Beining Wu,Yanfeng Jiang,Bohan Xu,Lixin Lin,Naye Ji,Hao Zhang,Yan Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MuDuo是一个互蒸馏框架，利用SAM-Med3D（CT）和SegAnyPET（PET）两种基础模型作为模态特异性通才，将知识蒸馏到轻量级学生网络中，在仅用5个标注样本的AutoPET数据集上实现最先进性能，无需手动提示即可充分利用未标注数据进行半监督PET/CT器官分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PET/CT器官分割对肿瘤学定量分析和放疗规划至关重要，但标注成本高昂。半监督学习虽为解决该问题提供了方案，现有方法仍难以高效利用未标注数据。视觉基础模型的发展为知识迁移提供了新可能，但如何弥合通用基础模型与任务特定精度之间的差距仍是挑战。

Method: 提出MuDuo互蒸馏框架，同时利用针对结构CT的SAM-Med3D和针对代谢PET的SegAnyPET作为模态特异性通才，通过蒸馏知识到轻量级学生网络，无需手动提示即可自动分割，最大化未标注数据的利用价值。

Result: 在AutoPET数据集上仅用5个标注样本即达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: MuDuo框架有效结合了两种模态的基础模型知识，在极少量标注数据条件下实现了高质量的PET/CT器官分割，为半监督医学图像分割提供了新的有效范式。

Abstract: Organ segmentation from PET/CT is critical for quantitative analysis and radiotherapy planning in oncology. To ease the high annotation cost of PET/CT segmentation, semi-supervised learning (SSL) provides a practical and effective solution for developing deep models with limited labeled data. Recent developments in visual foundation models have demonstrated remarkable adaptability with improved efficiency. In this work, we propose a mutual distillation framework that seamlessly exploits both structural and functional foundation models, which act as modality-specific generalists for distilling knowledge from structural CT and metabolic PET imaging. By bridging the gap between the task-specific precision of student models and the segmentation priors of generalist foundation models, we propose \textbf{MuDuo}, a mutual distillation framework that synergistically leverages SAM-Med3D for CT and SegAnyPET for PET to distill their knowledge into a lightweight student network. Our approach eliminates the need for manual prompts while maximizing the utility of unlabeled data for automatic segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the AutoPET dataset with only 5 labeled cases. Our source code is available at https://github.com/Wu-beining/MuDuo.

</details>


### [117] [Variational Test-time Optimization for Diffusion Synchronization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15614)
*Hyunsoo Lee,Farrin Marouf Sofian,Kushagra Pandey,Stephan Mandt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于最优控制的扩散同步框架，通过优化控制变量在测试时引导多条扩散轨迹协同生成一致结果，无需额外训练即可扩展预训练扩散模型能力，在三个协同生成任务上取得一致改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散同步方法依赖启发式策略和任务特定调整，缺乏通用性和性能保障，亟需一个理论严谨、场景无关的协同生成框架。

Method: 基于最优控制理论数学推导同步框架，在采样过程中优化控制变量，使多条扩散轨迹既保持与预训练先验接近，又朝向一致解协同演化，测试时运行无需额外训练。

Result: 在三个代表性协同生成任务（覆盖多种模态和应用）上，该方法相比基线方法取得一致性改进。

Conclusion: 该工作为协同生成建立了全新的理论基础，开辟了将预训练生成模型扩展到新协同生成场景的原则性路径。

Abstract: Collaborative generation, which coordinates multiple diffusion trajectories to extend the capabilities of pretrained priors, has emerged as a powerful paradigm for extending the applicability of diffusion models. Among existing approaches, diffusion synchronization provides a scenario-agnostic solution by introducing general guidance mechanisms. However, current synchronization approaches rely heavily on heuristics and still require task-specific tailoring, which limits their generalizability and performance. In this work, we mathematically derive a synchronization framework based on optimal control, providing a principled explanation of diffusion synchronization. During sampling, we optimize control variables to guide multiple trajectories toward coherent solutions while remaining close to the underlying diffusion prior. Our method operates entirely at test-time without additional training, thereby enabling broad applicability across diverse generation scenarios when combined with strong pretrained priors. We demonstrate consistent improvements over baselines on three representative collaborative generation tasks, covering a wide range of modalities and applications. Beyond performance gains, our work establishes a novel foundation for collaborative generation, opening a principled path toward extending pretrained generative models to new collaborative generation settings.

</details>


### [118] [NeRD: Neuro-Symbolic Rule Distillation for Efficient Ontology-Grounded Chain-of-Thought in Medical Image Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15617)
*Hongxi Yang,Yiwen Jiang,Siyuan Yan,Jamie Chow,Eunis Li,Charlotte Poon,Stephanie Fong,Xiangyu Zhao,Deval Mehta,Yasmeen George,Zongyuan Ge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出神经符号规则蒸馏（NeRD）框架，通过高效、本体驱动的推理链实现可解释的医学图像诊断，避免了传统概念瓶颈模型和生成式方法中概念冗余或偏离本体的问题，在皮肤病变诊断中取得了良好效果，并支持专家在环的干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释方法存在关键局限：概念瓶颈模型（CBM）需要在推理时对所有预定义概念评分，增加临床医生负担；基于理据的生成式方法常按类别判别性选择概念，偏离诊断本体论。

Method: 提出NeRD框架，通过神经符号规则蒸馏生成高效、本体对齐的推理链，在保持充分性的同时避免冗余，无需手工构建诊断规则。

Result: 在两个皮肤数据集上表现出强诊断性能和可解释性；盲法专家评估证实了NeRD理据的临床合理性；首次实现基于多模态思维链诊断的专家在环研究，达成高效有效的概念级干预。

Conclusion: NeRD有效解决了现有可解释方法在医学影像诊断中的实用性问题，同时保持诊断性能，并支持临床专家进行高效的概念级干预。

Abstract: Interpretability is essential for trustworthy medical image diagnosis. However, existing concept-driven interpretable methods have key limitations: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) require scoring all predefined concepts at inference time and for manual intervention, imposing a substantial burden on clinicians, while rationale-based generative approaches often select concepts by class discriminability, which can drift from diagnostic ontologies. To address these issues, we propose Neuro-Symbolic Rule Distillation (NeRD), a framework that produces efficient, ontology-grounded reasoning chains that are sufficient yet non-redundant, without manually crafting diagnostic rules. Experiments on two skin datasets demonstrate strong diagnostic performance and interpretability, and blinded expert evaluation confirms the clinical plausibility of NeRD rationales. Our method further enables a first expert-in-the-loop study for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought-based diagnosis, achieving efficient and effective concept-level intervention.

</details>


### [119] [XPASS-Vis: A Dataset for Cross-Domain Personalized Image Aesthetic Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15629)
*Takato Hayashi,Hiroaki Takahara,Candy Olivia Mawalim,Hiromi Narimatsu,Akisato Kimura,Shiro Kumano,Shogo Okada*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了XPASS-Vis，首个专为跨领域个性化图像美学评估（PIAA）设计的数据集，包含来自艺术、时尚、景观三个领域的6,526张图像、129名标注者、87,836条交互数据。通过无监督域适应（UDA）基线实验发现，最佳方法可恢复约60%的有监督上限性能，表明个性化审美偏好可在视觉域间迁移，但仍存在显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PIAA数据集和方法大多局限于单一领域，或每个领域内每位标注者的样本太少，无法支持跨领域个性化。因此，跨领域的个性化审美偏好的泛化能力尚未得到充分探索。

Method: 构建XPASS-Vis数据集（三个视觉领域，每位标注者在每个领域标注超过200张图像）；采用无监督域适应（UDA）框架，在标注源域训练后迁移至无标注目标域；系统评估多种代表性UDA方法。

Result: 最佳UDA方法在完全无监督设置下达到斯皮尔曼ρ=0.28，相当于有监督上限的约60%；跨领域迁移是可行的但仍有显著性能差距。

Conclusion: 个性化审美偏好在不同视觉领域间具有一定程度的可迁移性，但现有UDA方法尚不能完全弥合差距，亟需专为PIAA设计的适应策略。XPASS-Vis为跨领域PIAA研究提供了基础资源。

Abstract: Personalized image aesthetic assessment (PIAA) seeks to model, at the individual level, the subjective nature of aesthetic judgments toward artworks and photographs. Aesthetic preference is known to be both deeply personal and partially consistent across visual domains. Yet existing PIAA datasets and methods are largely confined to a single domain, or provide too few samples per annotator within each domain to enable personalization across domains. Consequently, the cross-domain generalization of personalized aesthetic preferences remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce XPASS-Vis, the first dataset explicitly designed for cross-domain PIAA. XPASS-Vis comprises 6,526 stimuli from three visual domains -- art, fashion, and landscape -- rated by 129 annotators, yielding 87,836 user-stimulus interactions, each annotated with an overall aesthetic score and nine aesthetic-emotion ratings. Notably, each annotator rated more than 200 stimuli per domain, providing sufficient per-domain coverage to support personalization both within and across domains. Moreover, we establish baseline models for cross-domain PIAA under unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA), where a model trained on a labeled source domain is transferred to an unlabeled target domain. A systematic evaluation of representative UDA approaches shows that the best-performing method recovers approximately 60\% (Spearman's $ρ$ = .28) of the supervised upper bound under a fully unsupervised setting. This provides encouraging evidence that personalized aesthetic preferences are, to a meaningful extent, transferable across visual domains. At the same time, a substantial gap remains, highlighting the need for PIAA-specific adaptation strategies. XPASS-Vis and the accompanying baselines provide a foundation for future research on cross-domain PIAA. All datasets and code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [120] [Open-World Video Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15632)
*Qing Su,Kaiyang Li,Yuan Zhuang,Fei Miao,Shihao Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了Savvy系统，结合层次化掩码发现、延迟确认和跟踪整合技术，用于零样本开放世界长时视频分割；同时提出了OGA评估套件，采用粒度无关（GA）匹配协议（n:1映射）替代传统1:1匹配，并引入了身份持久性（IP）和身份集中性（IC）等诊断指标。实验表明，传统1:1评估严重低估了开放世界方法的性能，而GA评估能恢复被抑制的表现，在VIPSeg、ScanNet和HM3D数据集上Savvy均优于强基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频分割方法在短片段和封闭集基准上表现良好，但开放世界视频分割仍未充分探索，面临两大挑战：（1）现有方法不支持动态自我运动下长视频中的物体发现和身份维持；（2）现有评估协议采用严格的1:1匹配，不公平地惩罚了粒度不匹配但语义有效的预测。

Method: 提出Savvy系统，包含层次化掩码发现、延迟确认和跟踪整合；提出OGA评估套件，基于粒度无关（GA）匹配协议，将1:1匹配放宽为n:1映射，并通过断点检测支持不连续性，通过主导连贯片段对每个参考对象进行评分，防止碎片化或闪烁的支持被过度奖励。

Result: 在VIPSeg上，标准1:1评估严重低估了开放世界方法，GA评估能恢复大部分被抑制的性能；在ScanNet和HM3D长时基准上，Savvy在STQ、VPQ∞、IP和IC等指标上持续优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 为开放世界长时视频分割建立了实用的基准和强基线方法，证明了粒度感知评估的重要性。

Abstract: While video segmentation has advanced rapidly on short clips and closed-set benchmarks, open-world video segmentation remains largely unexplored. The challenge is twofold: (1) existing methods are not designed to support object discovery and identity maintenance in long videos of dynamic ego-motion, and (2) existing evaluation protocols rely on a rigid 1:1 matching that unfairly penalizes semantically valid predictions with mismatched granularity. To address both gaps, we introduce Savvy, a practical and strong system for zero-shot open-world long-horizon video segmentation. Savvy combines hierarchical mask discovery, deferred admission, and track consolidation to support persistent object discovery, safe track promotion, and stable long-range identity maintenance. We further propose OGA, a granularity-aware evaluation suite for open-world video segmentation. Built on a Granularity-Agnostic (GA) matching protocol, OGA relaxes conventional 1:1 matching to an n:1 mapping, but still enforces temporal rigor by detecting support discontinuities through sever points and scoring each reference object through its dominant coherent fragment. This prevents fragmented or flickering support from being over-rewarded while enabling GA-adapted metrics and structural diagnostics: identity persistence (IP), and identity concentration (IC). On VIPSeg, we show that standard 1:1 evaluation substantially underestimates open-world methods, whereas GA evaluation recovers much of their suppressed performance. On the more realistic long-horizon benchmarks: ScanNet and HM3D, Savvy consistently outperforms strong baselines across both classical and proposed metrics, including STQ, VPQ$_\infty$, IP and IC. Together, these results establish a practical benchmark and a strong baseline for open-world long-horizon video segmentation.

</details>


### [121] [Fusing Transferred Priors and Physics-based Decomposition for Underwater Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15648)
*Haochen Hu,Yanrui Bin,Zhengyan Zhang,Minchen Wei,Chih-yung Wen,Bing Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于物理模型与先验知识融合的迁移学习水下图像增强方法（P2-UIE），无需配对标签即可实现SOTA性能，有效解决了伪标签噪声问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的UIE方法依赖数据集中的伪标签（来自先前方法的增强结果），这些伪标签存在噪声且真实标签难以获取，导致模型性能受限。

Method: 将UIE任务按水下物理模型分解为全局色彩校正、去雾和背景噪声抑制三个步骤，在每个步骤中利用其他视觉任务的多种先验知识作为跨域监督，通过迁移学习实现无需配对标签的增强。

Result: 定性和定量实验表明，该方法在UIE任务上达到SOTA性能，并有效提升下游视觉任务效果，显著优于基准方法。

Conclusion: 基于物理模型与先验融合的迁移学习方法能够有效解决UIE中伪标签噪声问题，具有理论完备性和实际优越性。

Abstract: The underwater images are captured within diverse water-medium conditions, leading to complex degradation, including color bias, low contrast, and blur effect. Recently, learning-based methods have demonstrated their potential for underwater image enhancement (UIE). However, most of the previous work focus on the training strategy or network design to make the enhanced result aligned well with the labels in datasets, ignoring that the labels are selected from the enhanced results of previous UIE methods and these pseudo-labels are noisy. Consequently, the performance of their models is not satisfactory to a certain extent. However, collecting the true labels of the underwater images is challenging. In this work, we propose a transfer learning-based UIE that does not require underwater images to have paired noisy or true labels for learning. Instead, the UIE task is first divided into global color correction, haze removal, and background noise suppression following the underwater physics. Then multiple types of prior from other vision tasks are leveraged as cross-domain supervision in each step. In this way, a novel UIE is available via transfer learning, and the physics-aligned UIE decomposition provides theoretical soundness. Qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our proposal based on physics and priors fusion achieves SOTA performance in the UIE task and effectively boosts downstream vision tasks, significantly outperforming benchmark methods. Project repo: https://github.com/Haru2022/P2-UIE.

</details>


### [122] [Self-Questioning Vision-Language Models: Reinforcement Learning for Compositional Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15651)
*Saraswathy Amjith*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自提问框架，利用GRPO强化学习算法训练VLM自动将视觉问题分解为子问题并逐步回答，无需人工标注的思维链数据，在CLEVR和A-OKVQA上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合视觉推理需要多步链式推理（识别、计数、比较），但人工编写逐步解释的标注成本高且难以扩展，现有VLM在此类任务上表现不佳。

Method: 采用GRPO强化学习算法，奖励信号不仅包含最终答案正确性，还包含是否生成中间子问题；模型自主发现问题分解策略，无需人工示例。

Result: 在A-OKVQA上，自提问方法准确率52.2%，标准RL方法51.6%，均显著优于未训练模型46.8%。

Conclusion: 让AI系统学会自我提问中间问题是复杂视觉推理的有效策略，尤其适用于需要显式逐步分解的困难问题。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are AI systems that process both images and text, yet they often struggle with compositional visual reasoning questions that require chaining multiple steps together, such as identifying objects, counting them, and comparing the results. Existing approaches improve this reasoning by training models on human-written step-by-step explanations, but creating these annotations is expensive and difficult to scale. We propose a self-questioning framework that trains a VLM to break visual questions into smaller sub-questions and answer each one before producing a final response, using a reinforcement learning algorithm called Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). The model is never shown examples of how to decompose questions, it discovers this behavior on its own, guided by a reward signal that scores whether the output contains sub-questions and whether the final answer is correct. We apply this framework to a 3-billion-parameter model, training on both synthetic scenes of geometric shapes (CLEVR) and real-world photographs (A-OKVQA). On A-OKVQA, both self-questioning and standard reinforcement learning substantially improve accuracy over the untrained model (52.2% and 51.6% vs. 46.8%). We introduce the first self-questioning VLM by rewarding not only the final answer like standard RL but additionally for generating intermediate sub-questions, enabling it to discover compositional decomposition strategies. These results suggest that teaching AI systems to ask themselves intermediate questions is a promising strategy for complex visual reasoning, particularly when the difficulty of a question warrants explicit step-by-step decomposition.

</details>


### [123] [SpatialAvatar-0: High-Quality 4D Head Avatar with Multi-Stage Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15659)
*Yiran Wang,Zeyu Zhang,Yuanming Li,Ziming Wang,Yang Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SpatialAvatar-0，一种基于FLAME网格绑定高斯表示的统一框架，通过参数无关的K源均值池化生成器和两阶段训练策略（单目时序→多视角空间），实现跨域零样本4D头部虚拟人重建，并引入10K迭代的布局保持精细优化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈预测器存在域偏置（单数据集、硬编码源数），而逐主体优化器需大量迭代且自适应致密化破坏高斯布局，导致两种范式无法端到端共享表示。

Method: 基于FLAME网格绑定高斯表示；参数无关K源均值池化前馈生成器；单目时序→多视角空间两阶段训练防身份先验坍塌；10K迭代布局保持优化（冻结FLAME绑定和高斯数量，三组件防尖峰正则化替代致密化）。

Result: VFHQ/HDTF跨域零样本超GAGAvatar +1.5dB PSNR；SplattingAvatar单目基准全面领先，超GeoAvatar +1.3dB PSNR，逐主体优化速度比主流基线快60倍。

Conclusion: 统一框架有效桥接前馈预测与逐主体优化两种范式，在跨域泛化性和效率上均取得显著提升。

Abstract: High-quality 4D head avatars from one or a few source portraits are central to telepresence, AR/VR, and digital-human interaction. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as the dominant representation, with two complementary regimes (generalizable feed-forward predictors and per-subject refiners) maturing in parallel. However, existing feed-forward predictors are trained on a single dataset family with a hard-coded source count, inheriting the corresponding domain bias. Per-subject refiners require 300K--600K iterations and rely on adaptive densification that destroys upstream Gaussian layouts, preventing the two regimes from sharing a representation end-to-end. To bridge both regimes we propose SpatialAvatar-0 on a shared FLAME-mesh-bound Gaussian representation: a feed-forward generator with a parameter-free K-source mean-pool and a monocular-temporal to multi-view-spatial two-phase schedule that anchors against identity-prior collapse onto the smaller multi-view set. We further introduce a 10K-iter layout-preserving per-subject refinement loop that freezes the FLAME-binding and Gaussian count and replaces densification with a three-component anti-spike regularization. On VFHQ/HDTF cross-domain zero-shot we surpass the in-domain leader GAGAvatar by +1.5 dB PSNR despite never training on either test domain, and on the SplattingAvatar monocular benchmark we lead every reported metric, surpassing the 300K-iter GeoAvatar by +1.3 dB PSNR at up to 60x shorter per-subject schedule than common SOTA baselines. Website: https://spatialwalk.github.io/SpatialAvatar-0.

</details>


### [124] [OneFocus: Enabling Real-World X-ray Security Screening with a Unified Vision-Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15663)
*Jiali Wen,Hongxia Gao,Litao Li,Yixin Chen,Kaijie Zhang,Qianyun Liu,Xiaoqin Wen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了MMXray基准数据集（52,124个X光违禁品图文对，28个细粒度类别）、CleanDET合成数据集、AnyContraSyn可控合成方法、OnePipe数据整理流程，以及统一视觉语言模型OneFocus，在X光违禁品检测的四个核心任务上取得了最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统X光违禁品检测器难以适应新型违禁品种类且缺乏基础视觉理解能力，视觉语言模型虽泛化能力强但受限于高质量X光图像-文本数据的稀缺。

Method: 构建MMXray基准数据集（52,124个图文对，28个细粒度类别）；提出CleanDET合成数据集（含28类干净前景违禁品图像及不同密度背景）与AnyContraSyn可控合成方法；开发OnePipe可扩展数据整理流程；提出OneFocus统一VLM，支持视觉问答、违禁品定位、分类和图像理解四个核心任务。

Result: OneFocus在X光违禁品理解任务上取得最先进性能，并展现出鲁棒的跨域泛化能力。

Conclusion: 本文建立的MMXray基准和OneFocus模型为安检领域提供了强有力的视觉语言基线，填补了X光图像-文本数据稀缺的关键空白。

Abstract: X-ray contraband detection is critical for security in large-scale logistics and transportation, yet conventional detectors struggle to adapt to emerging contraband types and lack fundamental visual understanding. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer strong generalization but are hindered by the scarcity of high-quality X-ray image-caption data. To bridge this critical gap, we present MMXray, a meticulously curated benchmark of 52,124 image-caption pairs spanning 28 fine-grained classes of X-ray contraband. To enrich MMXray with realistic occlusion patterns, we further introduce CleanDET, a dedicated synthesis dataset containing clean foreground contraband images from 28 categories and background images with diverse density levels, together with AnyContraSyn, a controllable synthesis method designed to operate on CleanDET. We also develop OnePipe, an extensible pipeline for systematic data curation. Built on MMXray, we propose OneFocus, a unified VLM that supports four core tasks: visual question answering, contraband localization, classification, and image understanding. OneFocus achieves state-of-the-art performance in X-ray contraband understanding and demonstrates robust cross-domain generalization, establishing a strong vision-language baseline for security screening.

</details>


### [125] [CEVAR: Centerline Embedding Extraction for Endovascular Aneurysm Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15667)
*Roman Naeem,Timo Niiniskorpi,Charlotte Sandström,Naman Desai,Anders Jeppsson,Ida Häggström,Fredrik Kahl,Håkan Roos,Jennifer Alvén*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于Transformer的全自动框架，结合3D中心线追踪与嵌入几何预测，实现EVAR术后支架密封区自动化评估。在常规和 challenging 无对比剂CT子集上，该方法均优于商业半自动工作流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EVAR术后长期死亡率因支架密封区失效导致破裂而居高不下。结构化CT中心线测量虽能改善检测，但现有工作流依赖人工中心线编辑和专业操作员，亟需自动化解决方案。

Method: 采用Transformer框架，结合3D中心线追踪与基于嵌入的几何预测。评估两种最新的图像到图模型，用于从随访CT中提取主髂动脉中心线，并根据EVAR4C协议测量支架位置、血管直径和密封长度。

Result: 在完整测试集和无对比剂测试子集上，全自动方法均优于商业半自动工作流。

Conclusion: 全自动Transformer框架可替代现有半自动工作流，实现EVAR术后密封区标准化、自动化的CT评估，有望改善临床监测效率与患者预后。

Abstract: Long-term mortality rates after endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR) remain elevated due to post-EVAR rupture caused by loss of seal in stent graft sealing zones. Structured CT review using centerline measurements improves detection, but current workflows require manual centerline editing and expert operators. We propose a transformer framework for automated, protocol-driven sealing zone assessment that combines 3D centerline tracking with embedding-based geometric prediction. Two state-of-the-art image-to-graph models are evaluated for aorto-iliac centerline extraction from follow-up CT and for measurement of stent position, vessel diameters, and seal lengths according to EVAR4C protocol. Across the full test set and a challenging no-contrast subset, the proposed fully automatic method outperforms the commercial semi-automatic workflow.

</details>


### [126] [3D Consistency Optimization for Self-Supervised Monocular Video Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15681)
*Yuanye Liu,Ke Zhang,Junzhe Jiang,Li Zhang,Vishal Patel,Xiahai Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的自监督单目视频深度估计范式，将视频深度估计重新定义为无约束的多视角3D重建问题，通过图像级光度渲染、世界坐标几何对齐和多尺度时间梯度一致性三个约束驱动的3D一致性优化框架，将孤立帧锚定到全局一致的3D结构上，在自监督训练和零样本临床环境中均取得了最优的空间准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督方法孤立处理视频帧或仅依赖弱时间正则化，缺乏对底层3D场景的整体感知，导致几何不一致的预测和严重的跨帧漂移。

Method: 将视频深度估计转化为无约束多视角3D重建问题，提出由三种约束（图像级光度渲染、世界坐标几何对齐、多尺度时间梯度一致性）驱动的3D一致性优化框架，利用3D基础模型的几何先验。

Result: 在自监督训练和零样本临床环境中均达到最先进的空间准确性，超越了基于帧、基于视频的深度估计器和多视角3D重建基线。

Conclusion: 通过统一优化将孤立帧锚定到全局一致的3D结构，有效解决了跨帧漂移和几何不一致问题，适用于内窥镜导航中的可靠深度估计。

Abstract: Reliable monocular video depth estimation is crucial for downstream 3D reasoning and embodied AI in endoscopic navigation. However, existing self-supervised approaches typically treat video frames independently or rely on weak temporal regularization. These methods, lacking a holistic perception of the underlying 3D scene, inevitably suffer from geometrically inconsistent predictions and severe cross-frame drift. To address these limitations, we introduce a new paradigm that recasts sequential video depth estimation as an unconstrained multi-view 3D reconstruction problem, enabling full exploitation of the powerful geometric priors embedded in recent 3D foundation models. The core of our approach is a 3D consistency optimization framework driven by three constraints: image-level photometric rendering, explicit world-coordinate geometric alignment, and multi-scale temporal gradient consistency. Such unified optimization elegantly anchors isolated frames to a globally coherent 3D structure. Our method has been validated in both the self-supervised training scenarios and challenging zero-shot clinical environments. Results show that the proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art spatial accuracy, outperforming the frame-based, video-based depth estimators and the multi-view 3D reconstruction baselines.

</details>


### [127] [OmniTraffic: A Controllable Generation Pipeline and Benchmark for Spatio-Temporal Traffic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15749)
*Maonan Wang,Zhengyan Huang,Kemou Jiang,Yuhang Fu,Jiayue Zhu,Yuxin Cai,Xingchen Zou,Qiaosheng Zhang,Yi Yu,Ding Wang,Xi Chen,Ben M. Chen,Yuxuan Liang,Zhiyong Cui,Man On Pun,Yirong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OmniTraffic是一个面向交通场景的时空推理可控生成管道与基准，基于12个真实路口构建可编辑3D环境，生成800万VQA样本和3000人工验证测试集，发现前沿多模态大模型在拓扑推理和时空推理任务上与人类存在显著差距，并通过模拟数据微调有效提升了模型在真实场景的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交通领域多模态基准大多侧重于被动视觉识别或孤立的视频理解，缺乏对结构化感知推理（如车道拓扑、多视角几何、时序演化和信号相位语义）在可控条件下的评估能力。

Method: 基于12个真实路口重建为可编辑3D交通环境，结合两个国家的监控视频数据，通过结构化交通元数据生成同步多视角VQA样本，涵盖车辆状态、车道功能、视角-BEV对应、时序动态和信号相位分析，形成三级任务层次（场景感知、多视角与时空推理、决策支持），共800万VQA样本和3000人工验证测试集。

Result: 评估11个前沿多模态大语言模型，发现人类与模型之间存在显著差距，最严重的失败集中在拓扑推理和时空推理任务上。通过模拟数据微调轻量级MLLM，在真实交通场景上取得了性能提升。

Conclusion: OmniTraffic不仅是一个固定数据集，更提供可扩展的管道，支持可配置的路口、视角、交通需求、信号相位、视觉条件和罕见事件，证明了仿真生成监督对于交通特定多模态推理的价值。

Abstract: Traffic scene understanding requires models to reason beyond object recognition, including lane topology, multi-view geometry, temporal evolution, and signal-phase semantics. However, existing traffic-oriented multimodal benchmarks largely emphasize passive visual recognition or isolated video understanding, offering limited support for evaluating structure-aware traffic reasoning under controlled conditions. We introduce OmniTraffic, a controllable generation pipeline and benchmark for spatio-temporal traffic reasoning. Built around 12 real-world intersections reconstructed into editable 3D traffic environments and complemented by surveillance footage from two countries, OmniTraffic supports both controlled and natural-condition evaluation. It defines a three-level task hierarchy spanning scene perception, multi-view and temporal reasoning, and decision support. Using structured traffic metadata, OmniTraffic generates synchronized multi-view VQA samples covering vehicle states, lane functions, view--BEV correspondence, temporal dynamics, and signal-phase analysis, resulting in 8M VQA samples and a 3K human-verified test set. Evaluation of eleven frontier MLLMs reveals a large human--model gap, with the most pronounced failures in topology-grounded and spatio-temporal reasoning tasks. Fine-tuning a lightweight MLLM on simulated OmniTraffic data further improves performance on real-world traffic scenes, demonstrating the value of simulation-generated supervision for traffic-specific multimodal reasoning. Beyond a fixed dataset, OmniTraffic provides an extensible pipeline with configurable intersections, camera views, traffic demands, signal phases, visual conditions, and rare events.

</details>


### [128] [The Circumplex Degeneracy Behind the Rare-Class Limit in Affect Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15763)
*Van Thong Huynh,Hong Hai Nguyen,Soo-Hyung Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过多任务研究发现，野外表情识别中稀有情绪识别失败的根本原因并非类别不平衡，而是情感几何结构问题：稀有类别在Russell环形模型上退化。论文提出基于圆周模型的最优传输代价项来调整表情混淆，但实验表明几何调整的主要效果是改变错误结构而非提升整体性能。最终结论是，解决稀有表情识别需要改进表征以区分类别，而非调整损失函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战"类别不平衡是稀有情绪识别失败主因"这一常见解释，通过受控实验证明失败根源在于情感几何结构——稀有类别在Russell环形模型上的退化性质，而非简单的数据分布不均。

Method: 1) 在两个基准数据集上进行受控多任务研究；2) 提出圆周模型-代价最优传输（circumplex-cost optimal-transport）项，根据价-唤醒距离来定价表情混淆；3) 设置均匀代价对照组（等效于通用置信度惩罚）以隔离几何效果；4) 构建基于动作单元的代价项尝试分离退化类别对。

Result: 1) 圆周代价项在官方指标和宏F1上有提升，但均匀代价对照组在Aff-Wild2上无显著差异（p=0.625），在AffectNet上反而显著超越圆周代价（+0.057）；2) 几何调整仅改变了错误的情感邻近性（Aff-Wild2 p=0.031），该效果在AffectNet上不显著；3) 稀有类别的失败跨数据集稳定存在：退化类别对（anger-fear / anger-contempt）抵抗所有干预手段。

Conclusion: 稀有表情识别的进步需要能够区分这些类别的表征，而非重新定价其混淆的监督信号。研究提供了必要的对照实验和评估指标，以区分表征问题与监督问题。

Abstract: In-the-wild expression recognition persistently fails on a few rare emotions, and the standard explanation is class imbalance. Through a controlled multi-task study on two benchmarks, we show the failure is instead a property of affect geometry: the rare classes are degenerate on Russell's circumplex, and that degeneracy bounds what any loss or cost can achieve. Our instrument is a circumplex-cost optimal-transport term that prices expression confusions by their valence-arousal distance. The term improves the official score and expression macro-F1, but a control most studies omit shows the gain is not geometric: a uniform cost, equivalent to a generic confidence penalty, matches it on Aff-Wild2 (p=0.625) and significantly exceeds it on AffectNet (+0.057 over base, larger than the circumplex).
